Note: [1] For chemotherapy drugs, Relative dose intensity (%) = (Actual dose intensity / Planned dose intensity)*100, Actual dose intensity (mg/m^2/frequency) = Actual cumulative
dose / Body surface area (BSA) / Total frequency of drug administration, According to the high ratio formula, Body surface area (BSA) =0.007184 × Weight (kg)0.425× Height(cm)0.725.
The last valid weight value and height value measured before each chemotherapy cycle will be used for calculating Body surface area (BSA).
Programming notes: relative dose intensity (%) is rounded to integer, and statistics for decimal places refer to SAP.
